skill.summary: Manage Bring! shopping lists - view, add, and remove grocery items from shared shopping lists. Use when the user wants to interact with their Bring! shopping list app, add groceries, check what's on the list, or remove items after shopping.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: Manage Bring! shopping lists with support for multiple languages. Features: view all lists, find lists by name, add/remove items, set default list, configure list languages (Italian, Spanish, English, German, French). Perfect for multilingual families.
